edits.before: Janna dominates the level 1-2 walk-up: her passive movespeed and Zephyr slow let her kite Alistar so he can never close to point-blank W-Q range, and every step he takes forward burns his already thin mana. Alistar has no answer to being poked and spaced, so he loses the ranged war outright and just wants to survive to his item spikes.

edits.before: By 3-6 Alistar looks for the flash W-Q all-in, but Janna's kit is built to deny exactly that: her Q tornado can be held to knock up mid-engage, and her W slows and disengages the moment he commits. When both hit 6, Janna's Monsoon is the single best counter to a telegraphed Alistar engage, throwing his whole dive back and healing the target.

edits.before: In 2-item teamfights Alistar can flank and land a knockup, but Janna simply Monsoons the engage back and shields her carries through his Trample, meaning his commitment rarely converts. She out-peels his peel and out-disengages his engage, so the duel of utility stays firmly in her favor at every stage.
